connector.name: Index One
connector.registryDescription: Query financial index data, run backtests, and deploy systematic investment strategies on Index One.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.indexone.io over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.indexone, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Index One team API key. Only needed by clients that cannot do OAuth; OAuth-capable clients (Claude connectors and similar) sign in with an Index One account instead and send no header. Create keys in the console under Team API Keys.
